list.description: End-to-end modular samples and landing zones toolkit for Terraform on GCP.

TerraGoat is Bridgecrew's "Vulnerable by Design" Terraform repository. TerraGoat is a learning and training project that demonstrates how common configuration errors can find their way into production cloud environments.
Terraform module, which takes care of a lot of AWS Lambda/serverless tasks (build dependencies, packages, updates, deployments) in countless combinations 🇺🇦
Terraform module to create AWS VPC resources 🇺🇦
Terraform module to generate well-formed JSON documents (container definitions) that are passed to the aws_ecs_task_definition Terraform resource
Terraform module to create AWS IAM resources 🇺🇦
Sets up a new VPC network on Google Cloud
Terraform module to create Amazon Elastic Kubernetes (EKS) resources 🇺🇦
Manages multiple IAM roles for resources on Google Cloud
Terraform module to create AWS EventBridge resources 🇺🇦
Terraform module to create AWS S3 resources 🇺🇦
DevOps Real World Projects for Aspiring DevOps Engineers [Beginner to Advanced]
This module creates an S3 bucket suitable for receiving logs from other AWS services such as S3, CloudFront, and CloudTrail
Creates one or more Cloud Storage buckets and assigns basic permissions on them to arbitrary users
